claims.text: During Falcon 9 first-stage recovery, an entry burn uses the engines to reduce the stage speed.
A final engine firing brings the Falcon 9 first stage to a soft landing.
During atmospheric descent, Falcon 9 grid fins steer the aerodynamic lift produced by its first stage.
Falcon 9 first-stage engines use liquid oxygen and rocket-grade kerosene, and can restart.
Falcon 9 carries carbon-fiber landing legs as part of the hardware for a safe first-stage landing; the legs and grid fins are stowed during ascent.
